Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Fix frontend Docker deployment and CORS configuration

Changes:
- Updated docker-compose.yml frontend env vars to use server IP \(192.168.39.196\)
- Removed nginx backend proxy \(unnecessary - frontend JS calls API directly\)
- Simplified nginx.conf to only serve static files and handle SPA routing
- CORS now handled entirely by backend config

This fixes the CORS errors where frontend was trying to connect to
localhost:8000 instead of the actual server IP.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(docker exec aads-frontend sh -c "cat /usr/share/nginx/html/assets/index-*.js | grep -o ''ws://[^""]*:8000/ws'' | head -3")

EOF
\)")

- Enhanced module visibility with better contrast
- Active module shows animated status stripe

- NATO STANAG APP-6 \(military symbology\)
- MIL-STD tactical display standards

EOF
